exam_scheme.note: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre recruits Stipendiary Trainees under two categories: Category-I (Diploma in Engineering / B.Sc.) and Category-II (HSC Science / SSC with ITI). For Category-I, the selection process comprises a Computer Based Screening Test of 40 multiple-choice questions (120 marks, 60 minutes duration, +3 marks for correct answer, -1 mark for wrong answer) testing diploma/B.Sc. syllabus knowledge. Shortlisted candidates based on the CBT screening appear for a personal Technical Interview. Final selection is based 100% on performance in the personal Interview, subject to qualifying the screening test and medical fitness.

stages.source_label: BARC Advt 01/2023 — Selection Methodology for Category-I Stipendiary Trainees

papers.negative_marking: -1 mark for each incorrect response (+3 marks for correct response)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit cutoff applied to shortlist candidates for Stage 2 Technical Interview in 1:5 ratio

financial_package.note: During the 2-year training period, Category-I trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹24,000 (1st year) and ₹26,000 (2nd year) plus a one-time book allowance of ₹3,000. Upon successful completion of training, Category-I trainees are absorbed as Scientific Assistant / C under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 7 (Entry Basic Pay ₹44,900; range ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400). Compensation includes central DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, PRIS incentive, and CHSS healthcare.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BARC Advt 01/2023 — Emoluments upon Absorption into Scientific Assistant/C
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + 30% HRA Mumbai (₹13,470) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + ₹2,088 DA on TA) = gross ₹90,100, in-hand ~₹81,000 after 10% NPS deduction.
official_perks: Contributory Health Service Scheme (CHSS) covering full medical care for employee and eligible dependents
DAE Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) bonuses
Departmental residential accommodation in DAE townships
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual allowances
